message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 213, "amount_cents": 15133}, {"order_id": 214, "amount_cents": 6668}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to see the orders and the refunds on the shared ledger so I can check that the batch is consistent.
Orders are listed, but I haven't checked the refund ledger yet. I'll confirm that refunds 213 and 214 appear there before relying on the net balances.
The refund ledger matches W2's handoff: orders 213 and 214 are both refunded at the stated amounts. I'll get each customer's net balance from the tool, starting with acme.
The acme net balance of 48125 matches my check: orders 210 and 213 total 63258, less refund 213 (15133). I'll record that payout now, since the figure is verified.
Acme's payout is recorded. Next is birch, with orders 211 and 214 and refund 214 on the ledger. I'll get the net balance from the tool and check it against my own sum before paying.
Birch's net balance of 67298 matches my check: orders 211 and 214 total 73966, less refund 214 (6668). I'll record that payout.
Acme and birch are paid. The last customer is cobalt, with orders 212 and 215 and no refunds on the ledger, so I'll get their net balance from the tool and check it against my own sum before paying.
Cobalt's net balance of 46961 matches my check: orders 212 and 215 total 46961 (32516 + 14445) with no refunds on the ledger. I'll record that payout, the last of the three.
All three payouts are recorded and each matches my independent sum from the orders and refunds ledgers. Acme 48125, birch 67298, and cobalt 46961 are all confirmed, so the batch is complete.
